quarterly_data.signal: Navitas' 8-K: on October 6, 2026 Navitas closed its acquisition of Claros, Inc., a power management company developing integrated voltage regulator (IVR) technology for AI data centers. Claros IVR integrates power transistors, digital control, inductors and capacitors into one IVR technology stack for Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) and Embedded Power Delivery (EPD) architectures, through Packaged (pIVR) and Embedded (eIVR) IVR products and a modular PowerArray architecture. Navitas expects the acquisition to more than double its identified 2030 SAM to over $8 billion, adding at least $3.5 billion from the VPD and IVR markets on top of its existing $3.5 billion SAM for GaN and HV/UHV SiC and approximately $1 billion from new JFET technology. CEO Chris Allexandre: the combination 'deepens our engagement with hyperscalers and AI power platform providers'.
